Published artifacts from my work in streaming systems, distributed data analysis,
applied machine learning, educational software, and IoT security. Each record
includes its author list, publication details, source links, and downloadable
BibTeX. Names are retained as printed in the original records.

## About these records

These works are listed on my [LinkedIn profile](https://www.linkedin.com/in/raxit65535/).
Publication details follow ProQuest, IEEE's Crossref deposits, and the IRJET
archive/PDFs. Dates use the precision available in those sources; the IRJET issue
dates both articles to July 2016. Bibliographic verification is distinct from
independent validation of a paper's findings.
